skill.name: deploy
skill.description: Guides agents through local build, dev server, browser, and test checks before production deployment.
skill.summary: Pre-deployment checklist that requires local verification before release.
skill.author: ChakshuGautam

security_audit.summary: The static shell execution alerts are Markdown code fences around documented commands, not executable Ruby backticks or hidden scripts. The skill does instruct an agent to run pnpm and Vercel commands, but the commands are visible, purpose-bound, and part of its deployment checklist. No prompt injection, exfiltration, or deceptive intent was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: The marker is a Markdown fenced code block introducing pnpm build, not runtime backtick execution. The command is hardcoded and used as a visible pre-deployment build check.
This location is the closing Markdown fence and explanatory checklist text. There is no Ruby backtick execution or dynamic shell interpolation.
The marker opens a Markdown fenced block for the hardcoded pnpm dev command. It documents an explicit local server check, not hidden code execution.
This is Markdown syntax ending the documented pnpm dev block. The surrounding text only requires the server to start successfully.
The Markdown fence introduces pnpm test as an optional test-suite check. The command is visible, hardcoded, and scoped to normal project validation.
This location is a closing Markdown fence after the pnpm test example. It is documentation markup rather than executable backtick syntax.
The Markdown fence displays an explicit vercel --prod command after required checks. The command can deploy, but it is the declared purpose and not disguised execution.
The heading and bullets warn against deployment mistakes, not system reconnaissance. No host profiling, environment enumeration, or inventory collection appears there.

content.value_statement: Deployment mistakes happen when code reaches production before local checks finish. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through build, server, browser, and test verification before deployment.
actual_capabilities: Requires a local build before deployment.
Starts the local development server as a pre-deploy check.
Directs browser testing for changed functionality.
Runs the test suite when tests exist.
Allows production deployment only after all checks pass.
limitations: Does not inspect application code or infer test coverage.
Assumes pnpm and Vercel are the expected project tools.
Requires access to local browser testing tools.
Can start long-running dev server and deployment commands.

use_cases.title: Prepare a frontend release
use_cases.description: Run build, local server, browser, and test checks before a frontend deployment.

use_cases.title: Gate a production deploy
use_cases.description: Require clear local verification evidence before allowing production deployment.

use_cases.title: Avoid rushed solo releases
use_cases.description: Use a repeatable checklist when shipping changes without a separate QA team.

prompt_templates.title: Run pre-deploy checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the deploy skill before deployment. Build locally, start the dev server, test changed flows in the browser, and report results.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Vercel release
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare this project for a Vercel production deployment. Run the required local checks and stop if any step fails.

prompt_templates.title: Audit changed functionality
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the recent changes, identify the impacted user flows, run the deploy checklist, and summarize which flows passed.

prompt_templates.title: Gate production deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Serve as the release gate for this repository. Execute the full local verification workflow, document evidence, and deploy only after every check passes.

output_examples.input: Deploy the app after my changes.
output_examples.output: The skill first requires local verification, then reports build, dev server, browser test, test suite, and deployment status.

output_examples.input: Check my form update before release.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies form interactions to test, verifies them in the browser, and blocks deployment if errors appear.

output_examples.input: Ship this Vercel project to production.
output_examples.output: The skill confirms the local checklist results before running the final production deployment command.

best_practices: Run the skill in a clean working tree when possible.
Confirm deployment target and credentials before final deploy.
Keep local test commands aligned with project documentation.
anti_patterns: Using the skill as a substitute for project-specific tests.
Deploying after build success without browser interaction checks.
Running production deployment in the wrong Vercel project or branch.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an agent through local verification before deployment.

faq.question: Does it deploy automatically?
faq.answer: It instructs deployment only after all required checks pass. Confirm the target before final release.

faq.question: Which tools does it assume?
faq.answer: It assumes pnpm, Vercel, and Chrome DevTools MCP are available.

faq.question: Can it work without tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It runs tests when tests exist, while still requiring build and browser checks.

faq.question: Is it safe for production?
faq.answer: It adds local safety gates, but production deployment still requires authorized credentials and review.

faq.question: Can I adapt the commands?
faq.answer: Yes. Update the skill file to match your package manager, test runner, and hosting provider.
